run_text_generation_pipeline: run the text generation pipeline on Habana Gaudi with custom prompts and measure throughput
run_gaudi_inference: run text generation inference iterations using GaudiTextGenerationPipeline and report tokens per second
setup_parser: setup the argparse CLI parser for text generation arguments like batch size and max new tokens
initialize_model: initialize the Habana model, tokenizer, and generation config using the utils module
measure_generation_time: measure text generation duration using HabanaGenerationTime context manager and compute throughput
